summary: Use the shared process-style authentication shell consistently for signup, email/passkey access and account recovery as well as organization discovery and tenant login.
userImpact: Public account pages share the same dark Carbon theme and process landscape, including loading and unavailable states.
configuration: Existing platform branding remains in effect; explicit light-shell callers can still select appearance=default.
security: Presentation only: provider selection, account creation, tenant discovery and authentication authority are unchanged.
documentation: The shared PublicAuthShell component retains its explicit appearance override for host extensions.
knownLimitations: This frontend change does not recover an unavailable tenant route or qualify successful authentication.
rollback: Restore the previous frontend-host package and frontend image; no data migration is involved.
validation: Regression coverage checks provider signup, loading, unavailable, self-hosted registration and email/passkey pages retain the process shell.
